draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 64th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 9th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 131, well after his grade rank (64th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Nate Washington. Testing concerns: vertical jump (12th percentile), broad jump (1st percentile). College production: 922 receiving yards in 2020, 10th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 68 career games and 3 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), receiving yards 45 (10th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 45 receiving yards against a median of 255, below the norm.
